narrative.overview:
Everything on a Peach page arrives when it is ready. Fruit is not rushed: it blossoms, sets and ripens, and the site behaves the same way. Headlines rise into place once, the lavender branch turns peach only where the visitor's attention goes, and the process art grows from blossom to green fruit to ripe peach exactly as fast as the reader scrolls. Nothing loops for its own sake and nothing shouts. When something moves, it is because a moment has arrived.

The world is an orchard through the day: deep brown-black night chapters, pale paper daylight chapters and full peach-coral chapters, with cream text the colour of blossom and peach coral as the fruit, the one colour that means "act here". The feel is warm and human, premium and crafted, playful in its details (the peach cursor, the ripening fruit, the magnetic buttons), and calm and clear in its reading. Big type, generous space and one strong idea per section keep it calm; the playfulness lives in small reactive details, never in noise.

Interaction is tactile and lively. Buttons lean toward the cursor, project cards stack as you pass them, and the cursor itself turns into a labelled peach disc over anything clickable. The motion is springy but settles quickly, and it is always gentler with reduced motion turned on.
keyCharacteristics: Colour by chapter: dark, light and coral sections alternate, each one full field of colour; flat colour, no glows.
Peach coral is reserved for actions, highlights and the fruit itself.
Large Inter display type with one Instrument Serif word as a counterpoint.
Fully round pills for actions; large, soft-cornered cards for content.
Motion that responds to the visitor (cursor, scroll), timed to settle quickly.

rules.name: The Ripe Fruit Rule
rules.body: Peach coral marks what is ripe to act on: buttons, the current step, the label of a section. Do not spend it on decoration.

rules.name: The One Red Band Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears at most once per page. On the homepage the closing band now sits inside the coral chapter and takes coral with ink text.

rules.name: The Chapter Rule
rules.body: Every section is one full field of colour, and the ground changes only at section edges (decided with the owner, 2026-10-13). Three chapters:

rules.name: The One Serif Word Rule
rules.body: A heading gets at most one Instrument Serif phrase, usually its last words ("works.", "peachy.", "No runaround."). Never set a whole paragraph in the serif.

rules.name: The Readable Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 15px (captions 13px, the floor). No tiny tracked capitals and no index numbers like "(01)" in front of section names.

rules.name: The Flat Light Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat colour. To lift something, step its tone up (Night Pit to Bark). No radial glows behind art or sections, and no drop shadows. The owner rejected the glows on 2026-10-13.

dos: **Do** give each section one chapter (dark, light or coral) and style components through the role tokens, so they work in all three.
**Do** use the house curve, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), for entrances and state changes; keep hover and press transitions at 0.2–0.3s.
**Do** let motion respond to the visitor (cursor, scroll position) rather than play on its own.
**Do** give every movement a reduced-motion version that keeps the state change and drops the travel.
**Do** gate hover effects behind fine pointers.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more.
donts: **Don't** use tiny uppercase tracked labels, monospace captions or "(01)" style section numbering.
**Don't** put glows or drop shadows behind art, sections or cards.
**Don't** use signal red anywhere except the closing band.
**Don't** animate layout properties (width, height, top, left); animate transform and opacity.
**Don't** add looping decorative motion that means nothing.
